title.narrative: Private/Public Partnership Project in the Water Sector

description.narrative: Private/Public Partnership Project to test new technology and know-how in the South African Water Sector.

The project activities consists of a series of smaller PPP projects centred on the application of Danish technology in a South African setting, undertaken by Danish companies and institutions in partnership with relevant South African companies, institutions and interest organisations. The projects should demonstrate new and innovative solutions to the problems facing the water sector and should, if possible and relevant, align with WWF-SA's programme of freshwater work focused on water stewardship and water security.
The condition for obtaining support (up to 400 000 ZAR per project) will be a commitment to provide documentation on impact, as well as guidelines in order to enable replication. These reports will be used for the preparation of the 'best practice manual' and the awareness raising efforts, which WWF will undertake.
The smaller PPP projects can be carried out as stand alone initiatives in the agricultural or mining sector, the municipal water installation or other part of the water sector.
